chunks: They swear by God they are with you, though in fact they are not. They are only a frightened lot.
ai.seo_question: What is the nature of the hypocrites' fear and false allegiance in Surah At-Tawbah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah At-Tawbah characterizes the Munafiqun whose outward oaths mask an inner state of terror (faraq) rather than genuine conviction, distinguishing them from the sincere believers. Their fear is not merely of persecution but of the divine reality, leading to a disconnection between their professed allegiance and their spiritual rank. This highlights the Shia emphasis on the depth of faith (iman) versus mere verbal declaration.
